title: About
subtitle: An unofficial .NET port of OpenList: same API surface, an in-house VFS and a media domain of its own.
tip_uptime: Time since the server process started.
tip_skew: Server time minus this browser's clock. A large gap means the two machines disagree about time.
tip_built_at: Write time of the server assembly - roughly when the backend was built.
tip_dist_built_at: Write time of dist/index.html - roughly when the frontend bundle was built. A pair of very different timestamps usually means one side was redeployed without the other.
footer: Unofficial port. API and UI are modelled on upstream OpenList, which is released under AGPL-3.0. This page only reads settings from the local server; nothing here is sent anywhere.
